in_hebrew.name: Vladamir
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Rule by God
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Vladamir הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Slavic elements 'vlad' (rule) and 'imir' (God). This name was borne by numerous rulers throughout Eastern Europe, most famously by Vlad the Impaler, Prince of Wallachia.

in_greek.name: Vladamir
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Rule by God
in_greek.long_meaning: Vladamir είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Slavic elements 'vlad' (rule) and 'imir' (God). This name was borne by numerous rulers throughout Eastern Europe, most famously by Vlad the Impaler, Prince of Wallachia.

in_latin.name: Vladamir

This name was borne by numerous rulers throughout Eastern Europe, most famously by Vlad the Impaler, Prince of Wallachia.
